## Description

A crescent-shaped desmid (200–350 × 35–55 µm) with two ridged chloroplasts and a terminal vacuole
with dancing gypsum crystals at each tip. It moves slowly by secreting mucilage through pores at the
tips, and somersaults.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A crescent [silhouette](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) (`bend` ~100° with both tips tapered) that glides very
slowly and performs [somersaults](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md): it fixes one tip with mucilage, stands on it
and falls to the other side, alternating tips. Interval and duration estimated.

## Not implemented yet

- Gypsum crystals in the terminal vacuoles are drawn but do not move by Brownian motion.
- Division really separates two semicells; here it constricts in the view
  ([bug](../../bugs/diatom-division-geometry.md)).
- No conjugation (zygospores).

## Unique and shared mechanics

Somersaults are unique to it; shares desmid [semicell](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) features with
*Cosmarium* and *Micrasterias* only through its group.
